name: [😱UPD 1] +1 Speed Hoverboard Escape
desc:
🚀 Welcome to +1 Speed Hoverboard Escape! 🚀

How to Play:
🚀When you ride your Hoverboard, you go faster!
👑Go through the obbies to get wins!
🔓Unlock new hoverboards that give you INSANE multipliers!
💪Rebirth to achieve new buffs!

If you’re having fun, don't forget to like the game and join the group! 😆
